policy.unobtainableRule: true if hard elective regions in requiredRegions exceed 3 (Misthalin/Havenhythe free; Karamja automatic_early not an elective pick)
policy.requirementSemantics: recommendedReq is AND unless notes say OR for alternate material sources

records.name: Masterwork staff
records.rationale: Self-source needs Vorago seismic (Asgarnia), Cywir (Desert), attuned crystal (Tirannwn), and untradeable Abyssal runic synapse via Abyss RC (Forinthry hard — not soft); free Misthalin covers Vorkath leather only.
records.notes: Catalog currently omits forinthry from requiredRegions while already hosting it. Wiki: synapse untradeable, Abyss-only. masterwork-staff-chain.json marks forinthry hard. Electives 4 > 3 → unobtainable for full ironman self-source. Eternal magic logs are Kandarin/Havenhythe pressure (OR), not hard. Time-rune/Anachronia soft for volatile bricks.

records.name: Conservation of Energy relic chain
records.rationale: Stormguard/Howl dig (Kandarin) + Invention Guild Experimental Aether Reactor craft (Asgarnia) + monolith harness (Misthalin free) — three-region AND, two electives.
records.notes: Keep all_required. Stacks with Ring of Vigour (separate DG/Forinthry path) — do not merge RoV into this row.

records.name: Masterwork Spear of Annihilation
records.rationale: Trim lock mirrors trimmed masterwork: praesulic (Asgarnia/Nex) + malevolent (Morytania/RoTS) AND; base Archaeology spear is separate densify (Anachronia host hint only).
records.notes: Do not promote Anachronia into requiredRegions unless base-spear dig materials prove hard-gated there. Imcando anvil / glorious bar smithing stay Asgarnia pressure.

records.name: Masterwork 2h sword
records.rationale: Wiki ironman essences: chaotic (Forinthry/DG) + drygore kalphite + Twin Furies demonic (Desert) + Artisans/glorious-primal hub (Asgarnia) — exactly three electives at the League pick cap.
records.notes: Undead dragon leather grip is Misthalin/Vorkath free or GE-tradeable — host for awareness, not elective. At electives=3 this is obtainable only if the whole 3-pick budget is spent on Asgarnia+Desert+Forinthry.

records.name: Masterwork bow
records.rationale: Hard essences: noxious weapon (Morytania Araxxor) + ascension crossbow (Kandarin Order of Ascension); glorious bars are Asgarnia soft infrastructure, not a third hard gate.
records.notes: Eternal magic branches/sap: Kandarin Piscatoris or Havenhythe nursery (OR soft). Keep Asgarnia as host for glorious-bar workshop scoring only.

records.name: Expansive essence pouch (70 essence, non-degrading)
records.rationale: Runespan/Rinsit/essence-mine exterior ladder is Misthalin-hard; 100 magical thread cord is Forinthry Abyss-hard — one elective + free start.
records.notes: Dinosaur leather (Anachronia) and some altar geography (Kandarin) are soft OR pressure only. Not a combat rune pouch.

records.name: Fury of the Small relic chain
records.rationale: Warforge dig + cave paintings (Kandarin) AND monolith offer (Misthalin free) — single elective.
records.notes: Do not hide Warforge behind monolith-only naming. Applies to Necromancy basic post-2026 modernisation.

records.name: Superior dragon claws (Wilderness hilt upgrade)
records.rationale: Base claws from tormented demons under Misthalin Senntisten taxonomy; Wilderness hilt is Forinthry — both needed for the superior pair.
records.notes: Competes with EoF-storing base claws. One elective (Forinthry) on top of free Misthalin.

records.name: Bonecrusher auto-pickup upgrade (Waiko / Boni)
records.rationale: Base bonecrusher from Daemonheim Rewards (Forinthry) AND Boni Waiko taijitu upgrade under Arc=Asgarnia packaging.
records.notes: Desert powder-of-burials support only. Do not re-emit base forinthry:bonecrusher. Achievement Bone to Pick With You tracks unlock.

records.name: Dark Facet of Passage (Passage of the Abyss infinite charges)
records.rationale: Dark onyx core is Forinthry/Wilderness; Passage of the Abyss Invention discovery/craft is Asgarnia — permanent imbue needs both ends.
records.notes: Destroy-on-imbue account unlock. Core opportunity cost vs Dark Facet of Grace/Luck. Abyssal wand/orb ingredients are soft residual, not extra region hosts.

records.name: Elite tectonic robe armour
records.rationale: Vorago tectonic + Virtus/praesulic (Asgarnia) AND draconic energy + untradeable chaotic remnant (Forinthry/DG) — true dual-region no-trade craft.
records.notes: Stones of binding shops (Yanille/Kandarin or Bandit Duty Free/Forinthry) are OR pressure, not a third hard required region.

records.name: Trimmed / custom-fit trimmed masterwork melee armour
records.rationale: Praesulic from Torva/Nex + Artisans custom-fit (Asgarnia) AND malevolent essence from RoTS (Morytania) — defining two-region melee power set.
records.notes: Base masterwork plates are global Mining/Smithing ore chain (not region-hard). Custom-fit NPC is Asgarnia-only even if armour was obtained elsewhere.

records.name: Reaver's ring
records.rationale: Heart of the Berserker (Rex Matriarchs / Anachronia) AND 10× berserker rings (Dagannoth Rex / Fremennik) — no single-region self-source.
records.notes: Wiki League badge already tags heart as Anachronia. Shared pattern with Stalker/Channeller.

records.name: Stalker's ring
records.rationale: Heart of the Archer (Anachronia) AND 10× archers' rings (Dagannoth Supreme / Fremennik).

records.name: Channeller's ring
records.rationale: Heart of the Seer (Anachronia) AND 10× seers' rings (Dagannoth Prime / Fremennik).
records.notes: Creation is heart + base rings — do not invent ED-token acquisition paths.

records.name: Emberkeen / Hailfire / Flarefrost boots (T90 glacor upgrades)
records.requirementMode: AND (primary); scale materials have OR alts
records.rationale: Base Steadfast/Ragefire/Glaiven boots are Fremennik glacors; primary upgrade glands/scales self-supply through Forinthry ED/rune-dragon packaging — two electives.
records.notes: OR: steadfast scales also drop in Temple of Aminishi (Arc→Asgarnia host) so Emberkeen can be Fremennik+Asgarnia without Forinthry; Hailfire/Flarefrost more ED2/ED3/rune-dragon locked. Prefer Anachronia enhanced style boots when that region is unlocked. Revisit if Equilibrium reassigns ED2/ED3/rune dragons.

deferredLater.name: Mattock of Time and Space
deferredLater.issue: requiredRegions lists 4 regions but detail says hard Tirannwn+Misthalin only; Anachronia/Kandarin are dragon-mattock / Imcando pressure. Elective count and hard vs soft need a dedicated 4-req pass.
deferredLater.action: Deep-research later; do not ship 4-AND unobtainable without proving each gate.

deferredLater.name: Masterwork plate → Orthen furnace core pressure stack
deferredLater.issue: Detail says hard Asgarnia + Anachronia for plate→core, but requiredRegions currently forinthry+desert+anachronia and hosts are inconsistent. Needs Asgarnia re-host and req cleanup.
deferredLater.action: Deferred research: confirm Orthen core recipe regions and whether autoheater/Superheat partners belong on this row.
